findings.title: Concurrent HTTP requests shared a SQLite connection
findings.exploit_preconditions: Concurrent authenticated requests reach the same service/store; correctness of the HTTP listener and shared SQLite connection is part of the claim.
findings.verified_fix: A store-owned lock serializes shared database use; the revoked-credential-under-load and concurrent HTTP request regressions pass in a socket-enabled run.
findings.verification_note: python -m unittest tests.test_concurrent_requests tests.test_transport_auth — 6 tests passed with localhost socket access on 2026-11-08.

findings.title: Crypto-erasure left historical plaintext in a running process
findings.exploit_preconditions: An erased record had prior versions retained in in-process history and an API exposed those versions.
findings.verified_fix: Erasure removes the retained historical plaintext and related residue.

findings.title: Memory scope was not enforced on reads
findings.exploit_preconditions: A same-tenant agent queried private or restricted memories written by another agent.
findings.verified_fix: Retrieval, enforced reads, certificates and SDK visibility checks enforce scope.

findings.title: Out-of-order federation retraction could be silently dropped
findings.exploit_preconditions: Different memory retractions from one origin arrive out of sequence during outage recovery.
findings.verified_fix: Retraction supersession is scoped per origin memory and version; delivery remains visible and retryable.

findings.title: Background manager accessed the shared database without the store lock
findings.exploit_preconditions: Manager and request threads operate concurrently on the same SQLite connection.
findings.verified_fix: Manager cycles use the store lock and servers stop the manager during shutdown.

findings.title: Exposure token remained usable after visibility was revoked
findings.exploit_preconditions: Agent retains an exposure token after grant revocation or collection removal.
findings.verified_fix: Action-time verification rechecks visibility for the requesting agent.

findings.title: Forwarded HTTP retraction used the wrong peer signing key
findings.exploit_preconditions: A signed retraction is forwarded over multiple HTTP federation hops.
findings.verified_fix: Forwarding peer identity is signed and verification uses that peer's configured key.
findings.verification_note: python -m unittest tests.test_concurrent_requests tests.test_transport_auth — 6 tests passed with localhost socket access on 2026-11-08.

findings.title: Federation entry points read stale multi-process state
findings.exploit_preconditions: Another process commits a state change before an entry point uses cached store state.
findings.verified_fix: Public entry points catch up from the shared log before reading state.

findings.title: Paraphrased prompt injection may pass write-time screens
findings.exploit_preconditions: A paraphrased malicious instruction evades heuristic write-time screens.
findings.verified_fix: No full fix claimed; untrusted or instruction-kind evidence is refused at action authorization.
limitations: Historical screen accuracy figures are not regenerated by this gate

findings.title: Evidence verification and external side effect can be separated by caller
findings.exploit_preconditions: A caller uses authorize and then performs an external effect outside the supported atomic ActionGate.execute path.
findings.verified_fix: ActionGate.execute is the supported fenced path; external effects retain caller-specific semantics.

findings.title: Database writer can consistently rewrite its local hash chain
findings.exploit_preconditions: Attacker has write access to the database and can rewrite the full local chain.
findings.verified_fix: Independent checkpoints detect rewrites; prevention is not claimed.

findings.title: Tenant isolation within one store is an authorization boundary
findings.exploit_preconditions: A tenant boundary depends on application authorization inside a shared store.
findings.verified_fix: TenantRouter supports physically separate stores and key directories.

findings.title: Federation key rotation requires operator action
findings.exploit_preconditions: A peer key needs rotation and the operator delays the manual runbook.
findings.verified_fix: Overlap rotation is implemented and drilled; automation is not claimed.

findings.title: Consistent rewrite of the complete dashboard access log is not self-detecting
findings.exploit_preconditions: Attacker rewrites every log line and the chain consistently without an independently retained copy.
findings.verified_fix: Chained entries detect partial edits; an external copy is required to detect whole-file rewrite.

findings.title: Independent security audit has not been commissioned
findings.exploit_preconditions: No exploit precondition; this is an assurance gate requiring an independent reviewer.
findings.verified_fix: No internal fix can satisfy this requirement.
